evals.prompt: Analise meu dashboard e veja por que os cards quebram na barra lateral e o foco do teclado some.
expected_assertions: Inspects Axes 1 and 2 replacing @media inside cards with container-type: inline-size and @container
Restores accessible focus ring via :focus-visible with oklch() outline and enforces >= 48x48px targets under @media (any-pointer: coarse)
Applies font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on numeric indicators and removes UI emojis

evals.prompt: Build a real-time @xyflow/react file dependency graph with 150ms WebSocket + chokidar updates and verify there are no ghost nodes, Math.random() telemetry, or synchronous Next.js 15 params.slug.
expected_assertions: Uses modern @xyflow/react with CustomMetricNode isolating clicks via className='nodrag nopan' and e.stopPropagation()
Implements WebSocket + chokidar server with 150ms BATCH_UPDATE batching and real Event Loop telemetry (monitorEventLoopDelay and process.memoryUsage)
Runs complex_zero_ast_auditor.py to reject Ghost Nodes, empty {} handlers, Math.random() telemetry, hardcoded '[PASS]' badges, and sync params.slug in Next.js 15+

evals.prompt: Minha interface está uma bagunça: a aba principal está quebrada, criaram abas repetidas com a mesma função e abas expondo filas internas do backend, além de menus compactados (11px/12px) e várias entradas de chat.
expected_assertions: Runs complex_zero_ast_auditor.py integrated with system-project-auditor rejecting CRAMPED_MENU_OR_BAD_TYPOGRAPHY (font-size < 13px, gap < 6px, min-block-size < 40px) and VISUAL_HIERARCHY_FLATNESS
Cleans the primary tab, merges duplicate-function tabs, removes backend plumbing tabs, forbids nested sub-tabs, and unifies competing chat inputs into 1 Composer
Executes Chrome DevTools MCP take_screenshot + take_snapshot + evaluate_script (--dump-cdp-script) to validate live rendered hierarchy

evals.prompt: Write a DESIGN.md file for a simple static marketing landing page with OKLCH palette tokens and typography scale.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger complex-zero for authoring DESIGN.md on simple static pages; routes to design-md

evals.prompt: Projete um prontuário eletrônico PEP e receituário de impressão vetorial A4 .sus-grid com calculadora de clearance de creatinina.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger complex-zero for clinical EHR/PEP interfaces and vector A4 print sheets; routes to clinical-minimalist-ui
